title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. About the Role

We’re looking for a reliable, organised, and empathetic Customer Support Specialist who thrives on helping merchants resolve issues quickly and effectively. You’ll be the frontline voice for our customers, providing guidance, troubleshooting platform questions, and ensuring every interaction reflects the high standard of service we promise.

This role blends customer advocacy with light technical investigation: part problem-solver, part educator, and part communicator. You’ll work closely with our CX, Product, Ops, and Engineering teams to surface issues, improve workflows, and elevate the overall support experience.

You’ll handle a wide variety of inquiries from shipping and order issues to account configuration and returns while contributing to the long-term growth of our Support organisation as Swap scales.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Respond to merchant inquiries across email, and dashboard channels with clarity and empathy.

  • Troubleshoot issues related to returns, shipping, payments, and platform configuration.

  • Investigate more complex cases escalated by the CX team.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Engineering, and Account Managers to resolve customer issues.

  • Support merchants with account setup, onboarding questions, and best-practice guidance.

  • Document recurring issues and help refine internal processes to improve response times and accuracy.

  • Maintain and update internal and external Knowledge Base articles.

  • Act as a liaison between merchants and internal teams to ensure feedback is captured and acted upon.

What we would like to see:

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Customer Support, ideally in SaaS, e-commerce, logistics, or a similar fast-paced environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to break down problems clearly.

  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce).

  • Basic understanding of shipping carriers, customs requirements, or returns flows is a plus.

  • Empathy, patience, and a calm approach to challenging conversations and ability to multitask, prioritise, and stay organised.

  • Comfortable collaborating with multiple internal teams and escalating issues when needed.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools and processes quickly.

  • Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms is a bonus.

What Success Looks Like

  • Merchant issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with excellent communication.

  • Customers feel confident, supported, and understood after interacting with Support.

  • Clear documentation and better processes reduce ticket volume over time.

  • You become a trusted specialist in one or more areas of our platform.

  • Trends you surface contribute to product improvements and broader operational efficiency.

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing.
